capa.apoio: We do things differently: how we listen, understand, plan and deliver.

quemSomos.apresentacao: A trading desk that is different in how it listens, understands, plans, executes and follows through. We bring together more than 36 media solutions across six areas of expertise, combining strategic intelligence and operational excellence to build the right path for each challenge.
manifesto: In the attention we give each client.
Different in strategy. In operations. In the care we put into every delivery.
Because we believe a trading desk can go beyond operating media.
It can understand before it proposes. It can be close when it matters. It can take on every challenge as its own.
And it can make what was agreed just the beginning.
We didn't choose to be different to compare ourselves.
We chose to be different because that is simply how we do things.
And when that way of working turns into trust, longevity and results, the difference stops being a claim.

produtos.chamada: New discovery contexts. New possibilities for brands.
produtos.descricao: It's not just showing up for an audience. It's showing up when there is intent. E.UP ChatGPT Ads places your brand in ChatGPT's conversational environment, at the moments when people research, compare and decide.

paginas.titulo: Contextual advertising within the new decision journey
paragrafos: Unlike media based only on audiences or keywords, ChatGPT Ads uses context and intent signals from the conversation to identify relevant brand exposure opportunities.

E.UP adds ChatGPT Ads as a new layer of contextual intelligence, combining media, context, intent, data and technology: based not only on who people are, but on what they are trying to discover, solve or decide at that moment.
paginas.faixa: Search → site → comparison → decision becomes question → exploration → comparison → recommendation → decision. ChatGPT Ads doesn't replace Google, Meta, YouTube, CTV, programmatic or streaming: it adds the layer of conversational intent.

cards.texto: Reach, awareness and consideration. Ideal for branding, launches, regional expansion and institutional campaigns.

The strategic layer that unites the two: the brand appears in contexts where its solution can be useful, not just “who” but “what” the person is trying to solve right now.

paginas.faixa: 2 campaign types · 3 to 10 creative variations per offer · geographic targeting by state. First-mover advantage: those who start now learn first and build their own benchmark.
